svg.title: The critical-germ Hessian chain rule gives bcab = cab. Retaining the nonwrapping indicator then recovers the actual projected matrix entry, including its zero branch. In particular the nonwrapping cutoffin each projected entry has already been transported before the label sum is taken. The transported direction norm on the section keeps tWa(ξ) and t 2(Wa(ξ) + Wb(ξ)) in precisely the original paid class. In particular the off-diagonal estimate recovers the explicit calculation
